correctness.rationale: Character Fourier transformations are invertible over Z_p[zeta_p], with p−1 a local unit. The exact first nonzero cyclotomic binomial coefficient gives valuation min(r,p−1−r), except the quadratic nonsquare eigenvalue, which cancels exactly under u↦c/u. Proof includes r=0, p=3, and determinant valuation. A standalone checker exactly verifies leading coefficients and exact cancellation, and numerically checks rank/kernel for ten primes.
